comment: The missed pair was C<A: C’s three-block plain stack beat A’s five-block residual stack despite having one additional LayerNorm. I overextended K1015’s residual preference; its warning concerns deep plain stacks, not C’s three-block architecture. K1009/K1033’s budget-dependent shallow preference deserved more weight, while K1056 correctly supported E. A plausible mechanism is that shorter feature paths generalize better after 32 epochs, but the ranking alone cannot establish that. Backtesting found one matching historical smooth-additive, 32-epoch, Adam-1e-4 comparison favoring shallower plain (q_4bd573). Lab evidence limits generalization: at shorter budgets and Δ≥0.1, shallower plain lost all six comparable pairs across five sets; no matched 32-epoch pairs were available. No broad new rule is justified.
